messages.text: Good morning. Here is today. Three things need you: the design review at 10, the contract that has to be signed before 1pm, and a call to your mother about Saturday. Everything else I have moved or handled.

**Handled overnight**

- Renewed the car insurance: same cover, £38 less than last year.
- Booked the boiler service for Tuesday morning; Alfred will be in.
- Sent the school the signed trip form.
- Booked the trattoria your mother liked last year for Saturday, six people at 7pm. They know it is a birthday.
You are a star. What should I get Mum? She says she doesn't want anything, obviously.

Two ideas, both arrive by Friday:

1. **A framed print of the harbour** where she grew up, from the photo you took in June. £64 framed, and it is the one she keeps mentioning.
2. **A year of the garden magazine** she borrows from her neighbour, with the first issue gift-wrapped. £45.

The print is the one she will not expect.

group.name: Lisbon offsite
group.description: Three days with the team in October

messages.text: The offsite is on: Lisbon, Tuesday to Thursday, eight of us. Kai, find travel. Chloe, clear the diary around it.

Best option is the 07:10 out on Tuesday and the 19:45 back on Thursday. Everyone fits on one booking and the fare is held until 6pm tomorrow. The hotel is a ten-minute walk from the venue, breakfast included.
Diary is clear for all three days. I moved the board prep to Monday and told Clara you are out of reach on Wednesday afternoon.
The proposal for the harbour museum is ready for your read. Two numbers need your sign-off before it goes at noon; I have highlighted both.
You are in 4C both ways, aisle, as usual. Your passport is valid until 2031, so nothing to renew.
The boiler service is Tuesday at 9. I will be in for the engineer, so you need not rearrange anything.

present.draft: Go with the print. And find me something to do on Sunday morning, just me.

status.detail: Ordering the print and checking Sunday

toolCall.title: Checking the diary
toolCall.output: Sunday is free until 1pm. Forecast: dry, 14°C.

reply.text:
The print is ordered: oak frame, delivered Friday, with a card in your words for you to approve tonight.

Sunday is yours until 1pm and the forecast is dry. Three ideas:

1. **The river loop** you saved in the spring. Eight miles, and the café at the halfway point opens at 9.
2. **A swim at the lido.** The lanes are quiet before ten and I can book the 8:30 slot.
3. **The photography exhibition** at the city gallery, which closes next week.

Tell me which and I will block the morning so nothing lands on it.
Flights are booked for all eight, seats together in rows 4 and 5. Boarding passes will be in everyone's inbox on Monday.
